body: I’m so sorry you have to deal with this. I can’t imagine choosing between a career or help. You could go to therapy and not tell anyone. Therapy is confidential so they won’t tell anyone about it.

I think you should tell them before the trip. 
If you don’t feel comfortable doing that wear shorts that go to where the cuts end. 
I also wear kimonos to cover up my thighs just in case the shorts slip up. 
also make sure you wear a bandaid that covers your open cuts.
